To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the most effective teaching method for teaching medical students and residents is the problem-based learning (PBL) method.

(1) the most effective teaching strategy is to use a combination of lectures, readings, and small group discussion; (2) the most effective method for teaching residents about child development and behavior is to use case-based learning; and (3) the most effective strategy for teaching residents how to conduct a developmental-behavioral history is to use a case-based approach in which the resident interviews a family member, and then the group discusses the interview.

the most important factor in the success of a program is the quality of the faculty and the quality of the program, and that the quality of a program is a function of the program's goals, the faculty's goals, and the faculty members' ability to achieve the program's and their goals.
